Sample tasks

Every task we deliver ships with the files behind it, so your team can read the brief, inspect the labels, rebuild the environment and run the checks. These examples show the structure. The full library is shared with clients during scoping.

Egocentric · Capture

Make tea, recorded from the POV

A contributor wearing a head-mounted camera makes a cup of tea in their own kitchen. Reviewers mark hand keypoints and object contact, split the clip into labelled actions (reach, grasp, pour, place) and write a plain-language narration.
